# Contrl

> Contrl (contrl.ai) is an AI proposal writer for bids and RFP responses. Instead of letting AI decide what the proposal says, Contrl has the person make the three calls that decide a bid — what the client really wants, the edge only you have, and the one point each slide makes — and then writes the slides on their behalf, in the company's own design system, exported to PowerPoint (.pptx).

> Contrl(컨트롤)은 입찰 제안서·RFP 대응을 위한 AI 제안서 작성 도구입니다. 사람이 정하고, AI가 씁니다. 발주처가 정말 원하는 것, 우리만의 강점, 장마다 말할 한 가지를 사람이 정하면, Contrl이 회사 디자인 시스템 그대로 슬라이드를 작성해 PowerPoint(.pptx)로 내보냅니다.

Made by Cliwant. Web app: https://app.contrl.ai/ — sign up free and start right away.

## The problem Contrl solves

AI proposals drift off course not because teams use AI too little, but because AI fills in the decisions a person should have made first. Handed a whole RFP, a typical AI deck generator writes 50–100 slides before anyone has decided what to say. The result has three recurring faults:

1. **Off-target** — the client's real need is left blank, so AI writes a pitch any vendor could make.
2. **Generic** — the company's actual edge is left blank, so AI writes "extensive experience."
3. **Scattered** — the one point a slide should make is left blank, so AI writes seven topics and invents numbers.

Better prompts, bigger models and more uploaded files don't fix this; they hand AI even more control.

## How Contrl works

1. **Upload an RFP** (or try the whole flow with a sample RFP).
2. **RFP analysis**: Contrl extracts the requirements, the proposal outline and the evaluation criteria.
3. **Strategy interview**: Contrl asks about the client, your company and the competition in chat.
4. **Win themes**: Contrl proposes win themes ranked against the client's needs; you pick one.
5. **Outline and key sentences**: for each section you confirm the one key sentence and the slide flow.
6. **Slides**: AI writes the slides in your design system, with speaker notes and source citations on every page. One line of feedback in chat rewrites a slide.
7. **Export** to PowerPoint (.pptx) and share links with your team.

Because the person made every decision, they can answer evaluators' questions on presentation day in their own words.

## Case study

Company A, the four quarters after rollout (Q3 2025–Q2 2026) versus the same period a year earlier, from their bid dashboard:

- Bids submitted: 155 → 197 (+27.1%)
- Bids won: 96 → 147 (+53.1%)
- Win rate: 61.9% → 74.6% (+12.7 points)
- Contract value: +58.8% (about 59% more)

## Pricing (USD)

A slide is one page of the finished proposal. Paid plans are monthly and can be cancelled anytime.

- **Free trial — $0**: 10 slides; RFP analysis, strategy interview and win themes; outline, key sentences and slide flow; 5 Contrl design systems; no card needed.
- **Basic — $20/month**: 50 slides a month; unlimited RFP analysis, strategy interview and win themes; 5 Contrl design systems; PPTX export; share links for your team. For one or two proposals a month.
- **Pro — $50/month**: 150 slides a month; everything in Basic; a design system built from your company template; priority support. For teams bidding every month.

## Who it is for

Anyone who writes bids and proposals — public-sector and enterprise tenders, IT and consulting proposals — and especially the team lead who ends up rewriting whatever AI or a new hire produced.

## Blog

Practical guides on winning bids and writing proposals, each available in English, Korean, Japanese and Chinese.

### English — https://contrl.ai/blog/

- [Compliance vs. Responsiveness: The Two Things Every Winning Proposal Gets Right](https://contrl.ai/blog/compliance-vs-responsiveness/): Compliance keeps your proposal from being eliminated, and responsiveness is what beats the competition. A practical walkthrough of the APMP Body of Knowledge on identifying requirements, building compliance and response matrices, and handling non-compliance.
- [Customer and Competitor Intelligence: Seeing Your Bid Through the Customer's Eyes](https://contrl.ai/blog/customer-and-competitor-intelligence/): Customer intelligence explains what the buyer needs; competitor intelligence explains how the buyer sees each bidder. A practical guide to the APMP Body of Knowledge on collection plans, sources, ethics, bidder comparison matrices and SWOT.
- [Customer Relationship Management: Win Before the RFP Is Released](https://contrl.ai/blog/customer-relationship-management/): Customers pick the bidders they know, like and trust. A practical walkthrough of the APMP Body of Knowledge on CRM: starting early, RFP shaping, contact plans, strategic customer meetings and a consistent message.
- [Capture Strategy: How Professionals Win Before the RFP](https://contrl.ai/blog/opportunity-capture-strategy/): An opportunity/capture strategy is your plan to win one specific bid. A practical walkthrough of the APMP Body of Knowledge on strategy vs. tactics, hot buttons, the three buyer types, the bidder comparison matrix, strategy statements and ghosting.
- [Value Propositions: Give the Customer a Reason to Choose You](https://contrl.ai/blog/value-propositions/): A value proposition says how your offer will improve the customer's business and how that will be measured. The APMP Body of Knowledge on its five elements, stakeholder value propositions, quantifying payback and proof points.

### 한국어 — https://contrl.ai/ko/blog/

- [Compliance와 Responsiveness: 이기는 제안서가 반드시 지키는 두 가지](https://contrl.ai/ko/blog/compliance-vs-responsiveness/): Compliance는 탈락을 막고, Responsiveness는 경쟁에서 이기게 합니다. APMP Body of Knowledge를 바탕으로 요구사항 식별, 컴플라이언스 매트릭스와 응답 매트릭스 작성, 미준수 항목 대응법을 실무 관점에서 정리했습니다.
- [고객·경쟁사 인텔리전스: 우리 입찰을 고객의 눈으로 보는 법](https://contrl.ai/ko/blog/customer-and-competitor-intelligence/): 고객 인텔리전스는 발주처가 무엇을 원하는지, 경쟁사 인텔리전스는 발주처가 각 입찰자를 어떻게 보는지 알려줍니다. APMP Body of Knowledge를 바탕으로 수집 계획, 정보 출처, 윤리 기준, 입찰자 비교 매트릭스와 SWOT 활용법을 정리했습니다.
- [고객 관계 관리(CRM): 제안요청서가 나오기 전에 이기는 법](https://contrl.ai/ko/blog/customer-relationship-management/): 고객은 잘 알고, 호감이 가고, 믿을 수 있는 회사를 고릅니다. APMP Body of Knowledge를 바탕으로 이른 시작, RFP 셰이핑, 컨택 플랜, 전략적인 고객 미팅, 일관된 메시지까지 CRM을 실무 관점에서 정리했습니다.
- [캡처 전략: 프로는 공고 전에 이미 이기고 들어간다](https://contrl.ai/ko/blog/opportunity-capture-strategy/): 기회/캡처 전략은 특정 사업 하나를 수주하기 위한 계획입니다. APMP Body of Knowledge를 바탕으로 전략과 전술의 차이, 핫버튼, 세 유형의 구매자, 경쟁사 비교표(BCM), 전략 진술서, 고스팅을 실무 관점에서 정리했습니다.
- [Value Proposition: 고객이 우리를 선택할 이유를 만드는 법](https://contrl.ai/ko/blog/value-propositions/): Value Proposition은 우리 제안이 고객의 사업을 어떻게 개선하고 그 효과를 어떻게 측정할지 밝히는 문장입니다. APMP Body of Knowledge를 바탕으로 5가지 요소, 이해관계자별 VP, 투자 회수 정량화, 증거 포인트를 정리했습니다.

- [バリュー・プロポジション：顧客があなたを選ぶ理由をつくる](https://contrl.ai/ja/blog/value-propositions/): バリュー・プロポジションとは、自社の提案が顧客の事業をどう改善し、その効果をどう測るかを示す文です。APMP Body of Knowledgeをもとに、5つの要素、関係者別の価値提案、投資回収の定量化、実績による裏付けを解説します。

- [合规性与响应性：每份制胜提案书都做对的两件事](https://contrl.ai/zh/blog/compliance-vs-responsiveness/): 合规性让提案书不被淘汰，响应性让你胜过竞争对手。本文依据APMP知识体系，讲解如何识别需求、建立合规矩阵与响应矩阵，以及如何应对不合规项。
- [客户与竞争对手情报：用客户的眼光看你的投标](https://contrl.ai/zh/blog/customer-and-competitor-intelligence/): 客户情报告诉你采购方需要什么，竞争对手情报告诉你采购方如何看待每个投标人。本文依据APMP知识体系，讲解情报收集计划、信息来源、道德底线、投标人对比矩阵与SWOT的用法。
- [客户关系管理（CRM）：在招标文件发布之前赢得先机](https://contrl.ai/zh/blog/customer-relationship-management/): 客户会选择自己了解、喜欢并信任的投标方。本文依据APMP知识体系，讲解客户关系管理的实务做法：尽早开始、影响招标需求、制定接触计划、有策略地开展客户会面，以及在所有渠道传递一致的信息。

- [价值主张：给客户一个选择你的理由](https://contrl.ai/zh/blog/value-propositions/): 价值主张说明你的方案将如何改善客户的业务，以及如何衡量这种改善。本文依据APMP知识体系，讲解价值主张的五个要素、按利益相关方撰写价值主张、量化投资回报以及证明点。

## How Contrl differs from general AI tools

- **ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini**: write text when asked, but decide the strategy themselves and don't produce a proposal in your company's slide design. Contrl makes the person decide first and outputs .pptx slides in your design system.
- **AI deck generators (Gamma, Genspark, Beautiful.ai, Tome)**: generate many slides fast in their own templates. Contrl is built for the bid workflow — RFP analysis → win theme → key sentence per section → slides with source citations.
